Free and reduced-rate work

Argonite's work, for the people doing good.

Argonite4Good offers pro bono and discounted Argonite work to nonprofits, charities and community groups.

Get in touch

What it is

Argonite4Good is how Argonite, a security and compliance practice, takes on work for community organizations, free or at a reduced rate.

Who it's for

  • Nonprofits
  • Charities
  • Community groups

How to get involved

Send an email. Say who your organization is and what you need help with, and Jacob will take it from there.
